description: This file contains utility functions for handling URIs and paths, including conversion, parsing, and manipulation of URI paths, as well as functions for finding and generating relative paths and suffixes.

methods.name: pathToUriPathSegment
methods.description: Converts an OS-specific path to a URI path segment, replacing backslashes with slashes and encoding each segment.

methods.name: getCleanUriPath
methods.description: Extracts and cleans the path component from a URI or treats a plain path, removing leading and trailing slashes.

methods.name: findUriInDirs
methods.description: Finds a URI within a list of directory URI candidates, returning the relative path and directory where it was found.

methods.name: getUriPathBasename
methods.description: Returns the filename or last segment of a URI path, decoded.

methods.name: getFileExtensionFromBasename
methods.description: Extracts the file extension from a filename.

methods.name: getUriFileExtension
methods.description: Returns the file extension of a URI.

methods.name: getLastNUriRelativePathParts
methods.description: Gets the last N parts of a URI's relative path.

methods.name: joinPathsToUri
methods.description: Joins multiple path segments to a base URI, encoding segments appropriately.

methods.name: getShortestUniqueRelativeUriPaths
methods.description: Generates the shortest unique relative paths for a list of URIs within given directory candidates.
